relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin is an agonist of TRPV1 that reduces its activation threshold.

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: It induces the release of calcitonin gene-related peptide

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 activation induces release of substance P, which can drive gastrointestinal inflammation

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Some evidence suggests that capsaicin may inhibit signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3)

key_findings: Capsaicin activates TRPV1 and then induces a long-lasting refractory (defunctionalized) state underlying analgesia; an 8% patch is FDA-approved for neuropathic pain.
Capsaicin has antioxidant, antitumor, antiobesity and gastroprotective effects, some TRPV1-dependent and some independent, limited by short half-life.
